summary.text: While serving as Secretary of Veterans Affairs, Douglas A. Collins' official account stated in October 2025 that AI is helping the VA provide faster and more efficient services without cutting corners [s2]. At a January 2025 confirmation hearing, he said he was willing to consider AI to process veterans' benefits faster, while also saying he did not want AI used randomly, especially with benefits [s6][s9][s10]. In a May 2025 hearing, he described adding AI and other tools to help doctors, nurses, and practitioners and holding Oracle accountable for realistic time limits [s8]. An October 2026 VA policy document stated that the Chief AI Officer was designated as vice chair of the VA SI Governance Council and described the chair's coordination role under OMB Memorandum M-25-21 [s11][s12].
